items.source: An Iterator over multiple Windows obtained via a window function, that keeps track of the current ScrollPosition allowing scrolling across all result elements.
items.translation: 一个通过window function获取多个Windows的Iterator，它跟踪当前的ScrollPosition，从而允许在所有结果元素之间滚动。
